title: elitea.audit.v1 evidence event
description: One audit evidence event, as exported to a SIEM by the OTLP logs and signed webhook exporters (ADR-0042 decision 3). Producers: services/elitea-main/internal/auditexport maps securityaudit records, centry.audit_events rows and elitea_runtime.run_steps rows (the step records of a run) to this envelope, and the security signal stream maps security_signal ledger rows to the same envelope. OCSF mapping (https://schema.ocsf.io): event_id -> metadata.uid; time -> time; source -> metadata.product.feature.name; ocsf.class_uid / ocsf.category_uid -> class_uid / category_uid; tenant.project_id -> cloud.project_uid; actor.id -> actor.user.uid (actor.type decides user, service or agent); actor.email -> actor.user.email_addr; action -> activity_name; target.type / target.id / target.name -> resources[].type / uid / name; outcome -> status_id (success, failure) and authorization disposition (allow, deny); correlation.trace_id -> metadata.correlation_uid; details.http_method / http_route / status_code -> http_request.http_method / url.path / http_response.code. chain.* and details.* have no OCSF attribute and travel in unmapped. A field is omitted, never null, when it has no value, except tenant.project_id which is null for platform-wide events. Adding an optional field is not a version change; renaming, removing or retyping one, or adding a required one, is a new schema version. A receiver ignores fields it does not know; the schema stays strict for producers so that a producer typo fails CI.

schema.description: The schema version. A consumer rejects or quarantines a version it does not know.

event_id.description: Stable identifier of the event. Delivery is at least once, so a consumer deduplicates on it. A security audit event keeps its CloudEvents UUID; an audit_events row has a name-based UUID derived from its row id.

time.description: When the audited operation happened (UTC, RFC 3339).

source.description: Which evidence stream produced the event. security_audit is the security audit outbox; admin_audit is centry.audit_events (the HTTP access audit behind the admin Audit Trail); run_step is one step record of an agent or pipeline run (ADR-0042 decision 1); approval and suspension are reserved for ADR-0042 evidence added later; security_signal is one row of the security signal ledger (ADR-0058).

event_type.description: The producer's event type: a CloudEvents type such as ai.elitea.security.v1.decision for security_audit, or the audit_events event_type (api, socketio, rpc, agent, tool, llm, schedule, admin_task) for admin_audit, or run_step.<kind> (model_call, tool_call, retrieval, approval, delegation, cap, error, output) for run_step, or security_signal.<signal type> for security_signal. A chain.checkpoint event has event_type "chain.checkpoint" and no signal object.

ocsf.description: The OCSF class when one fits (3003 Authorize Session, 3004 Entity Management, 3005 User Access Management, 6003 API Activity). Omitted when no class fits.

project_id.description: The tenant project. 0 is the platform partition of the security audit chain; null means the row carries no project.

id.description: A user id, a principal reference or an agent identity reference. "unknown" when the producer recorded none.

chain.description: The RFC 8693 actor chain, outermost first, as references.

fidelity.description: How faithfully the actor chain was established (ADR-0039 decision 5).

role.description: What the actor has to do with the signal: subject (the actor did the thing) or affected (the actor's run met the thing). Only the security_signal stream sets it.

action.description: The governed operation (credential.use, grant.revoke) or, for admin_audit, the label "METHOD /route".

type.description: The kind of the target. "application" is the agent or pipeline for a security_signal event.

release_id.description: The release id of the agent, next to the application id. Present on a security_signal event of an agent.

target.description: What the action acted on, when the producer recorded it.

outcome.description: allow and deny are authorisation decisions; success and failure are the result of an operation.

conversation_id.description: The conversation the signal was reported in, as a string uuid.

partition.description: The hash chain partition: the tenant project id (0 is the platform) for security_audit; 0 for admin_audit (one platform-wide chain); run:<run id> for run_step (one chain per run).

sequence.description: Position in the partition chain: 1, 2, 3 with no gap.

prev_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the previous event; 64 zeros for the first event of a partition.

hash.description: Hex SHA-256 over prev_hash and the canonical stored event, not this envelope. security_audit: the stored CloudEvents form, verified with the elitea-main security audit verifier. admin_audit: the canonical form of the centry.audit_events row (centry.audit_event_canonical), verified by the admin audit chain verification route. run_step: the stored step record, verified by the run's verify route; a run's chain is anchored into its tenant's security_audit chain by an ai.elitea.security.v1.run.steps.anchored event whose details carry chain_head and chain_length.

chain.description: Present when the producer keeps a tamper-evident chain: always for security_audit and run_step; for admin_audit on every row written since centry.audit_events was chained (shared migration 0206), absent on older rows. A gap in sequence for admin_audit is either a row deleted by retention (verification starts at the retention anchor) or a break.

type.description: Stable dotted name (for example access.authn_failed, derived.repeated_prompt_attack). A pattern, not an enumeration: a new type must not break a strict receiver.

taxonomy_version.description: The version of the registry the producer used.

category.description: The first segment of the type.

severity.description: The value after the deployment's overrides.

default_severity.description: The registry value, before the deployment's overrides.

confidence.description: The declared confidence of the detector.

author.description: The subject surrogate of the uploader, the skill author or the message sender.

self_supplied.description: true when the author is the actor.

digest.description: The keyed digest of the untrusted part.

claimed.description: true when the client gave the provenance and it is the only one.

step_ref.description: The step reference of the part.

locator.description: Optional and content-free: the step reference, the part index and the byte range of the matched span. Numbers and ids only.

attribution.description: Whether the signal is attributable to an execution.

items.description: A bounded label: a detector label, a framework tag or a reason code. Never matched text.

count.description: The number of signals a summary replaces.

folded.description: The event ids, run ids and conversation ids (uuids) of the signals that a summary replaced.

dedup_key.description: A keyed hash of the type, the project, the subject surrogate, the agent, the detector, the disposition and, for a signal with no subject, the client key.

origin.description: Where the signal came from. A client-reported signal is never treated as verified.

digest.description: A digest of a whole stored artifact, never of a matched span.

ref.description: A capability: signed, expiring and bound to this signal.

signal.description: One security signal. The fields are ADR-0058 decision 1; the registry of E0.1b owns the types, severities and the OCSF class. The actor of a signal is a surrogate or a pseudonym, never a clear user id or email.

details.description: Source-specific fields. The shape is fixed per source; approval and suspension add theirs later.

length.description: The number of rows in the partition up to the checkpoint.

delivery_seq_high.description: The sink's delivery_seq high-water mark for the partition.

chain_status.description: broken_since=<sequence> on a partition with a break; deleted on the final checkpoint of a removed partition.

key_id.description: The checkpoint key that signed the event.

outbox_seq.description: The global outbox sequence, for tracing a record to its row.

chain_head.description: On ai.elitea.security.v1.run.steps.anchored: the hex hash of the anchored run's last step.

chain_length.description: On ai.elitea.security.v1.run.steps.anchored: the anchored run's step count.

elevationStep.description: On ai.elitea.security.v1.admin.elevation (ADR-0059 decisions 5 and 8): one step of a break-glass elevation. Ids, codes and numbers only. There is no reason text and no note text: the reason code is reason_code, a note is note_id and note_length, and the texts stay in the elevation ledger.

source.description: How the step was taken; operator is a process command.

elevation_id.description: The elevation. Present on every action except credential_issued, credential_revoked and local_admin_signin, and on credential_used when it started one.

user_id.description: The person elevated, or who signed in.

expires_at.description: The elevation's expiry, once it has started.

end_reason.description: On ended and expired: why access stopped.

note_length.description: On note_added: the note's length in characters.

credential_id.description: On the credential actions: the sealed credential.

accessChange.description: On ai.elitea.security.v1.admin.access.changed (ADR-0059 decision 8): one change of who holds what. Names and ids only. There is no reason text: the reason code is reason_code, and the text stays in the admin audit row.

mode.description: The role mode of a role change (administration, default).

source.description: The grant history source of a role assignment: console, api, scim, migration, bootstrap, operator or review.

before.description: The subject's set before the change, by name. On project_permissions_pushed, the permissions the push removed from the role in at least one project; on role_renamed, the old name.

after.description: The subject's set after the change, by name. On project_permissions_pushed, the permissions the push added to the role in at least one project; on role_renamed, the new name.

fields.description: The fields a provider or trust change changed, never their values; project_role_copies on a role delete or rename that also reached the project copies; roles_assigned on a push that gave the role to every member.

elevation_id.description: The elevation the change was made under.

reason_code.description: The reason code the caller gave.

http_route.description: The matched route pattern, never the raw target.

acting_roles.description: ADR-0059 decision 8: the caller's standing administration roles at request time, by name. An empty array is a credential that acts with no administration role (a none token, a run token, a system token). Absent when not recorded (a row written before the field existed, or a request with no administration resolution). In the row hash of a row chained in canonical form elitea.audit_events.v2.

elevation_id.description: The break-glass elevation the request was made under. Absent when none.

credential_kind.description: The kind of credential the request came with (ADR-0059 decision 7). Absent when unknown, never a guess.

central_override.description: The write went through the central override: an administration-mode permission reached a project the caller is not a member of.

reason_code.description: The reason code the caller gave. The reason text is never exported.

reason_missing.description: A reason was required and not given.

elevation_flagged.description: The action was done under an elevation and the action table flags it for the elevation review.

runStepDetails.description: One step record. It carries digests and references of the step's inputs and outputs, never the content: the content stays in the platform's object storage under its own retention (step_content) and is read through the run evidence API.

step_id.description: The worker's step id, unique per run.

seq.description: Position in the run, equal to chain.sequence.

generation.description: The execution generation that reported the step (a resumed run is a new generation).

application_id.description: The agent or pipeline, when the run is one.

release_id.description: The agent release the run executed (ADR-0040).

name.description: Tool, model, approval or delegation target, cap name or error code, by kind.

summary.description: Small structured fields per kind (model, token counts, decision, cap value, error code), at most 8 KiB.

retrieval.description: Retrieval steps: the index, query, filters, top_k and the returned documents with scores and ranks.

digest.description: Hex SHA-256 of the stored content; absent when the side was empty or filtered to nothing.

original_size.description: Size before the worker cut it.

filtered.description: The toolkit's evidence_fields setting filtered the stored tool result.

ref.description: <bucket>/<key> of the stored object; absent once the content expired.
